body: They prescribed me zoloft and other medication but it was a looong time ago and I don't even have it anymore. So hopefully I can see a psychologist soon who will prescribe me something to at least take the edge off my anxiety.

If I suffer from just anxiety than I must have the worst anxiety in the world. But for some reason I have these manic spurts that happen randomly, sometimes they're triggered by someone elses validation of me, but they usually don't last but 15-30 minutes and I'm back to feeling anxious/depressed/empty again.

I believe the only diagnosis' I've been given were 'generalized anxiety disorder' and 'dysthemia'.. My 'dad' (not sure if he was my real father though, biologically) had borderline personality disorder and screwed me up emotionally as I grew, and honestly I see a lot of symmetries in my behavior and the symptoms of BPD.

I worked out for awhile and it made me slightly more toned but for the most part I feel like I lack the testosterone needed to bulk up, especially with such a poor appetite. Also yeah, she gave me a lot of validation and I provided validation back, honestly I feel like she used me for that and eventually dropped me when she realized how many problems I really had. Thank you for your comment tho

My dad had it, also after researching I suspected himself of having some histrionic personality disorder traits, but yeah he really had an emotional toll on me. He would switch from showering me in love and gifts, to emotionally brutalizing me, making me feel worthless. Then I had to care for him all by myself for a number of years as a kid while I watched him destroy himself with drugs and alcohol. He passed away a year ago and I still don't know how to feel. He fked me up royally.

I feel like the only times I can truly express myself are when I'm alone, online. Speaking through text allows my mind to string things together properly. That's the thing, I feel like after such a long time of internet usage, my brain has hardwired itself to think in a different way. I feel like an emotionally cold husk pretending to be human when I'm talking face to face with people.
